audit_status_at_freeze.rule: Freeze-time provenance; not mutable evidence of later approval. E-001 outside read/claim closure. DM IDs remain owned by Claude.

verification.method: Data-free 60-step bisection of F1(t)=erf(sqrt(t/2)); F3(t)=F1(t)-sqrt(2t/pi)*exp(-t/2), using Python math. NIST table independently cross-checks three-decimal references. Diagnostic decisions use exact operational rationals, never these numerical CDF values.

claim_boundary.allowed_conclusion: The declared model is flagged by this diagnostic under the stated uncertainty/dependence assumptions.
claim_boundary.interpretation: The experimental-only NIST model is already flagged internally; the cross-campaign diagnostic remains conditional under that same model and is not independent confirmation.

known_prior_information.disclosure: Source numbers, published discrepancy, earlier estimator outputs and source discussion were known before freeze. Source review, cutoff verification and input-contract validation occurred before freeze; new diagnostics and result-bearing notes are post-anchor work.

source_review.evidence_access: NIST full relevant PDF passages accessible; BIPM publisher full-page/PDF access failed (403/internal error), with relevant indexed publisher passages available and existing corrected attestation inherited. No new BIPM PDF-byte/transcription verification claimed.
source_review.review_scope: Bounded passages only; not exhaustive absence. Full rho envelope retained regardless of source suggestions.

sources.access: indexed passages plus frozen upstream attestation; full publisher response inaccessible

sources.access: PDF text pp.3-5,25-28 and Table 18/19 page screenshots inspected

value.interpretation: Use the 2014 Philosophical Transactions treatment as the authoritative corrected detailed estimator source; the erratum corroborates the corrected 2013-result provenance.

value.precision_policy: Table 18 precise combined relative standard uncertainties control estimator covariance; Table 16 whole-ppm uncertainty labels are display-only corroboration.

value.absolute_standard_uncertainty_rule: For displayed midpoint x_i in units of 1e-11 and relative standard uncertainty s_i ppm, u_i = x_i * s_i / 1e6 in the same displayed units.
failure_conditions: correlation matrix not symmetric with unit diagonal
linear solve singular or normalization denominator zero
value.matrix_arithmetic: exact rational Gaussian elimination; no binary floating-point decision path
value.point_estimate_rule: G_hat = sum_i w_i x_i using the displayed midpoint values.
value.weights_rule: Solve V z = 1 exactly; w = z / sum(z). Do not constrain weight signs.
